      "evidence": "Modifies CI workflows and setup scripts to remove the requirement for privileged Docker containers and host kernel header installation in the ASan job.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes privileged container execution and dynamic host kernel header fetching in CI. The PR description notes that 'The ASan CI job no longer needs a privileged container and uses SYS_PTRACE instead', improving CI environment hygiene and reducing maintenance overhead."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/tracing.md (+18 lines) merely to reflect the test harness changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The documentation updates are secondary documentation following the test framework refactoring rather than a standalone documentation change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces a GDB-based tracepoint wrapper in test/functional/test_framework/usdt.py and refactors all USDT test suites.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Makes USDT functional tests runnable without elevated root or BPF privileges, allowing developers to execute them in standard local environments. Replacing BCC/eBPF with GDB drops complex tooling dependencies and deletes roughly 660 lines of embedded C/BPF code across five test suites."
